description: This Dart source file defines the 'AttendanceRemoteSource' class, which serves as a client interface for interacting with a backend API for student attendance tracking. It handles authentication (login/logout), token storage, fetching daily and weekly attendance data, marking attendance, and subscribing to real-time attendance events via SSE.

classes.name: AttendanceRemoteSource
classes.description: A client for interacting with the attendance backend API, providing authentication, attendance marking, data retrieval, and real-time event subscription.

methods.name: _uri
methods.description: Constructs a URI for API endpoints based on the base URL and given path and query parameters.

methods.name: _authHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves authentication headers with the Bearer token if available.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login by sending credentials to the backend and storing the returned token and user info in SharedPreferences.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears stored authentication token and user information from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: hasToken
methods.description: Checks if an authentication token is stored.

methods.name: markAttendance
methods.description: Marks attendance for a student on a specified date and period, indicating presence or absence.

methods.name: getDaily
methods.description: Fetches daily attendance data for a given date.

methods.name: getWeekly
methods.description: Fetches weekly attendance data starting from a given week start date.

methods.name: subscribeAttendanceSse
methods.description: Subscribes to real-time attendance updates via SSE Endpoint and provides events to a callback function.
